title: Markdown往返与并发写入验证

harness.note: Existing gitignored dual-profile fixture contracts already contain T03 Markdown, concurrency, shutdown, and recovery fields. T03 did not re-run just contract / python -m scripts.tasks contract. Fixture contract is not native GUI, Job Object, or real-user-vault evidence.

AC08.claim: Write MCP envelopes stay accepted_unverified until wait_note observes a unique sentinel in sandbox/vault Markdown. Policy, schema, rpc_or_transport, tool isError, rejected, and unclassified remain distinct. UI copy and process exit are not persistence proof.
unverified: production vault or Cloud disk state
search index freshness as a success signal

AC10.claim: Unknown custom frontmatter (bmdock_custom/keep-me and concurrent unknown_frontmatter), Chinese body (保留中文与关系), and wiki-links ([[Missing Target]] / [[Concurrent Target]]) survived create, append, and post-shutdown file reads on both isolated profiles.
unverified: official-normalization diff presented as a separate approved UI surface
golden comparison against a user vault rather than generated fixture notes

AC15.claim: Two independently owned bmdock-probe processes wrote distinct fixture notes in one generated sandbox. Both files were observed; both envelopes stayed accepted_unverified; frontmatter and wiki-links were preserved. This is not co-authoring and does not prove silent-overwrite protection.

AC16.claim: The probe never retries after TimeoutError, wait_note timeout, policy, schema, rpc_or_transport, or tool errors. Rust timeout_unknown emits 'Result unknown. No retry was performed.' and stops the session. Live lost-response, cancel-after-accept, and timeout_unknown injection were not executed.

AC17.claim: Normal close observed event=shutdown, sdkClosed=true, process.forced=false, exitCode=0. Markdown including Chinese, frontmatter, wiki-link, and a single append remained on disk after shutdown. Process exit is labeled not_proven_by_process_exit.
unverified: in-flight request drain under a product Supervisor
official lifespan cleanup outside the G0 probe receipt

AC18.claim: Recovery fault injection is recorded as UNVERIFIED. Clean shutdown, accepted_unverified envelopes, and distinct-target concurrent success were not treated as forced-kill, sleep-resume, or disk-failure proof. Generated bmdock-fixture sandboxes only.
